title: Discrepancy between sortBy and transformItems
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
In refinenementList, `sortBy` and `transformItems` do not work on the same type of items.

In sortBy the objects are the ones manipulated in the helper with the following keys:

* name
* count
* isRefined

In transformItems, items have the following keys:

* label (equivalent of name)
* value (legacy, comes from the SFFV API)
* count
* isRefined
* highlighted (for SFFV)

As a user you have to figure out the shape of the object and it's tricky to handle two versions of similar things that are not unified. Also sortBy doesn't work on sffv. Finally the sortBy is implemented at the Helper level which makes it hard to unify it with the transformItems API.

**Expected API 💭**

Only have one way to sort (transformItems) or implement sortBy at the IS.js level so that we can use the same standardized structure for the facet items.
